criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: No documented Ref2VA compatibility or exact-product test; the credited original bridge explicitly excludes Ref2VA.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Publisher comparison clips and approximate observations are not a formal benchmark; no AIVP hands-on run.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Alpha, magnitude matching and true bypass are documented and visible in source; multi-seed repeatability is untested.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Documented as a small ComfyUI conditioning-path insertion, but it depends on a complete specialist MiniMax H3 workflow.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: No render timing, overhead measurement or failure-rate evidence.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Adapter is publicly downloadable, but H3 hardware, electricity, setup and cost per accepted output are unmeasured.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Metadata points to MiniMax's community licence and Australia is not excluded; candidate repository lacks visible LICENSE/NOTICE and derivative-package compliance is unresolved.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Public ComfyUI source provides bounded file discovery, safetensors loading, shape validation and no shell/network calls in nodes.py; full audit not completed.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Australia is inside the upstream licence territory, but a local 33B workflow is not ordinary creator access.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate programme or validated transactional demand found.

analysis: A genuinely differentiated community conditioning component for complex action logic, but not a creator-ready tool. Its evidence is publisher-only, reference-product compatibility is undocumented, hardware feasibility is poor on the current host, and derivative-package compliance is unresolved.
confidence_notes: Primary repository, source code and upstream documentation only; no AIVP generation run.

hard_gates.product_affiliate: Blocked pending three paired exact-product first-frame/first-10-seconds passes.
hard_gates.publication: First Look only; Review blocked pending controlled artifact-backed AIVP evidence.
hard_gates.integration: Blocked pending full security audit, compatible no-cost NVIDIA access and licence/package review.
